capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Ford 2023 spec sheet: ER 131 kWh usable (2025 sheet also 131; the 2025 Platinum column is marked on the 131 kWh row only). Replaces the imported OpenEV 123 kWh on the 2025 car.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Battery Design lists the 2022 ER pack at 349 V x 408 Ah = 142 kWh total, from published Ford specs (limited data on the page). A published figure, not an independent test. Replaces the imported OpenEV 131 kWh (that is the usable figure).

ac_max_kw.notes: Ford 2023 spec sheet: ER 19.2 kW / 17.6 kW (Ford-quoted maximum input / output). Applies to the 2022-2024 cars; the 2025 car is overridden to 11.3 kW (2025 sheet). The 2024 sheet was not available, so 2024 is unproven.
